Row.Text: 需要先研究“造船术”，陆军才能通过桥梁。
Requires Shipbuilding so land units can cross the bridge.

沿直线跨越 1 格浅海或湖面，两端须落在陆地，桥头归属不限，可连接普通市中心；避开山地、运河区域和带运河外观标记的市中心，接桥的岸边不能有悬崖。全部桥身水格须属于生产城市，且无资源或其他区域。可清除的地貌、改良设施会在确认时列出；多格桥的后续水格在桥梁完工时清除。由城市生产建造，保留原有水域。[NEWLINE]途经桥梁的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 商路沿用原版运输效率规则，可提高来自目的地区域的 [ICON_Gold] 金币收益。加成取决于整条路线，并计入商路显示和结算。[NEWLINE]建造前还需研究“造船术”。陆军通行遵循所属文明的登船科技条件。

City-produced bridge across one Coast or Lake tile. Land approaches may have any owner and may include ordinary City Centers. Mountain, Canal and canal-marked City Center approaches are excluded, and each approach edge must be cliff-free. Every deck tile must belong to the producing city and have no resource or other district. Removable features and improvements are listed before confirmation; support tiles are cleared when construction finishes.[NEWLINE][ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes passing through the bridge use the game's transportation efficiency rules and can multiply [ICON_Gold] Gold from districts at their destination. The bonus depends on the complete route and is included in normal trade yield displays and settlement.[NEWLINE]Construction also requires Shipbuilding. Land traversal follows the unit owner's embark technology requirements.

沿直线跨越 2～3 格浅海或湖面，两端须落在陆地，桥头归属不限，可连接普通市中心；避开山地、运河区域和带运河外观标记的市中心，接桥的岸边不能有悬崖。全部桥身水格须属于生产城市，且无资源或其他区域。可清除的地貌、改良设施会在确认时列出；多格桥的后续水格在桥梁完工时清除。选址后确认跨度和生产力，基础造价为 162 或 243。[NEWLINE]途经桥梁的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 商路沿用原版运输效率规则，可提高来自目的地区域的 [ICON_Gold] 金币收益。加成取决于整条路线，并计入商路显示和结算。[NEWLINE]建造前还需研究“造船术”。陆军通行遵循所属文明的登船科技条件。

Cross 2–3 Coast or Lake tiles in a straight line. Land approaches may have any owner and may include ordinary City Centers. Mountain, Canal and canal-marked City Center approaches are excluded, and each approach edge must be cliff-free. Every deck tile must belong to the producing city and have no resource or other district. Removable features and improvements are listed before confirmation; support tiles are cleared when construction finishes. Base costs are 162 or 243.[NEWLINE][ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes passing through the bridge use the game's transportation efficiency rules and can multiply [ICON_Gold] Gold from districts at their destination. The bonus depends on the complete route and is included in normal trade yield displays and settlement.[NEWLINE]Construction also requires Shipbuilding. Land traversal follows the unit owner's embark technology requirements.
